topic: Student protests over compulsory hijab, university fees and campus welfare
scale: Dozens of university students rallied at Tehran's Allameh Tabatabai University on Sept 28; sit-ins and cafeteria boycotts also reported at Alzahra, Lorestan and Razi universities
quote1: Dozens of university students staged a rare protest in Iran, where the authorities have waged an intensifying campaign against dissent amid the war with the United States.
quote2: Iranian university students protested against compulsory hijab and worsening economic conditions, with Basij forces accused of threatening demonstrators during the campus gathering.
